sources.title: Census 2022 Statistical Release P0301.4
sources.methodology: Official published Census 2022 aggregate results. Keep Stats SA attribution and do not resell the underlying/reprocessed dataset as a standalone data product without permission.
sources.universe: South African Census 2022 population/households as defined by each cited table.

sources.title: Census 2022 in Brief
sources.methodology: Official Census 2022 five-year age-group counts by province from Table 3.4. Percent shares are deterministically derived from the published table totals.
sources.universe: Census 2022 population with specified age in each published province total.

sources.title: General Household Survey 2025 P0318
sources.methodology: Official annual household survey; bootstrap observations are published aggregate percentages from Table 14.1.
sources.universe: South African households represented by GHS 2025.

sources.title: Quarterly Labour Force Survey Q2 2026 P0211
sources.universe: Persons aged 15-64 for the reported labour-market measures.

sources.title: South African Census 2022 10% Sample
sources.methodology: Edited anonymised 10% Census sample. DataFirst requires a free account and a non-reidentification declaration. Aggregate queries must retain sampling and quality caveats.
sources.universe: Households and persons in the Census 2022 10% sample; lowest released geography is local municipality.
qualityNotes: Country of birth has a reported 42.3% aggregate index of inconsistency against the PES and must carry a quality caveat.
Income and employment sections were not released in the 2022 microdata due data-quality concerns; use GHS/QLFS instead.
